# ERM Triggers (WoG 3.58f)

Sources: `ERM_Triggers[]`, `InitTrigger`, the comment block with event numbers, and the `*Call` functions in
`T1/erm.cpp` (S1); descriptions come from the triggers page of the ERM help (S3).
"Event id" is the internal number generated by the engine. C#: `ErmEventIds`.

| Trigger | Event id | When it fires | Context for receivers | Version |
|---------|----------|---------------|-----------------------|---------|
| `!?FU#` (1…30000) | # | `FU:P`, `DO:P`, or a call from the engine/network | `x1…x16` = arguments | 3.5x |
| `!?FU-#` (1…100) | 31000+#−1 | local function, only within its own file | | **3.59** |
| `!?TM#` (1…100) | 30000+#−1 | start of a player's day, if timer # is due to fire (`RunTimer(owner)`) | current player | 3.5x |
| `!?TM a/b/c/d` | 31100+i | auto-timer (first/last day/period/owners) | | **3.59** |
| `!?HE#` (0…155) | 30100+# | hero # is attacked by an enemy hero or visited by an allied one (before combat; once more after combat if # won) | `HE-1` = hero | 3.5x |
| `!?BA0`/`!?BA1` | 30300/30301 | start/end of any battle (attacker's PC) | battle context | 3.5x |
| `!?BA50…53` | 30350…30353 | network variants; 52/53 — on both sides | | 3.58 |
| `!?BR` | 30302 | every battle round (the first one twice: −1 and 0) | `v997` = round | 3.5x |
| `!?BG0`/`!?BG1` | 30303/30304 | before/after each action in battle | `v997` = round, `BG:` | 3.5x |
| `!?MW0`/`!?MW1` | 30305/30306 | wandering monster reached its destination / was killed | `v997` = id | 3.5x |
| `!?MR0/1/2` | 30307…30309 | magic resistance calculation (before/after/"dwarven") | `MR:` | 3.58 |
| `!?CM0…4` | 30310…30314 | mouse click: map / town / hero screen / two heroes / battlefield | `CM:` | 3.5x |
| `!?CM5` | 30319 | click on the map (right button) | | 3.5x |
| `!?AE0`/`!?AE1` | 30315/30316 | unequip/equip an artifact (before the action) | `HE-1` owner, `v998` artifact, `v999` slot | 3.5x |
| `!?MM0`/`!?MM1` | 30317/30318 | mouse over the battlefield / over a town | | 3.5x |
| `!?MP` | 30320 | MP3 playback starts | | 3.5x |
| `!?SN` | 30321 | any WAV/M82 sound | `SN:` | 3.58 |
| `!?MG0`/`!?MG1` | 30322/30323 | adventure map spell, before/after | | 3.5x |
| `!?TH0`/`!?TH1` | 30324/30325 | entering/leaving the town hall | | 3.58 |
| `!?IP0…3` | 30330…30333 | network battle data exchange | | 3.5x |
| `!?CO0…3` | 30340…30343 | commander dialog opened/closed, commander bought, resurrected | | 3.58 |
| `!?GM0`/`!?GM1` | 30360/30361 | after loading / before saving | | 3.58 |
| `!?PI` | 30370 | post-instruction: once after the map is set up, **new game only** | | 3.58 |
| `!?DL` | 30371 | callback of a custom dialog | `v998` dialog, `v999` element, `v1000` action | **3.59** |
| `!?HD`,`!?CI0/1`,`!?FC`,`!?DG`,`!?AI` | 30372…30377 | hint, town income/growth, flag color, Grail digging, importance for the AI | | **3.59** |
| `!?HM#` (−1, 0…155) | 30400 / 30401+# | before each step of a hero (−1 = any, runs first) | `HE-1` moving hero, `v998…v1000` step target | 3.5x |
| `!?HL#` (−1, 0…155) | 30600 / 30601+# | hero gained a level (−1 first) | `HL:` | 3.5x |
| `!$HL#` | 31200… | after the level-up | | **3.59** |
| `!?BF` | 30800 | battlefield prepared (before combat) | `BF:` | 3.5x |
| `!?MF0`/`!?MF1`… | 30801… | monster abilities in battle (defense coefficient, block, hatred) | `MF:` | 3.58 |
| `!?TL0…4` | 30900…30904 | real-time timer 1/2/5/10/60 s | | **3.59** |

| `!$OB x/y/l` | …\|0x08000000 | after the visit | | 3.5x |

| `!?GE#` | global event address | global (timed) event whose text starts with # | | 3.5x |

## Ordering rules (from the code)

1. When an object is visited, the engine generates, in order: the positional `OB x/y/l`, then `OB type/subtype`,
   then `OB type` (`ERM2Object`) — each pre-trigger before the native visit, and the `$` post-triggers after it, in the same
   order.
2. `HM-1` runs before `HM#`; `HL-1` runs before `HL#` (different event ids, generated in this order).
3. Battle start: `BA0` (or `BA50` on the defender's PC in a network game), then `BA52`; then `BF` when the field is prepared;
   then `BR` with `v997=-1` (before tactics), `BR` with `v997=0`, then `BG0`/`BG1` for every action, and `BR` for every
   round. End: `BA1`/`BA51`, then `BA53`.
4. Within a single event id — all sections in load order (§6 `01_ERM_Language.md`).
5. `FU:E` ends the section; the next section of the same event still runs.

## Era additions (NOT WoG 3.58, excluded)

`77001…`: save write/read, key press, hero screen, stack turn, regeneration, interaction hooks,
damage hook, chat, entering/leaving the game, daily timer, battlefield visibility, after tactics (`Erm.pas`).
Listed only so that they can be recognized.
